needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, purpose-built footway along the left side to provide a safe pedestrian path away from the road.
Construct a continuous, purpose-built footway along the right side to provide a safe pedestrian path away from the road.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at this busy junction to allow safe crossing of the road.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the signalised crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait.
Install dropped kerbs at the pedestrian crossing to enable wheelchair users and mobility scooters to access the footway safely.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and cyclists, especially during low-light conditions.
